scenes.say: Ever had your app crash because of a null reference? Let's see how C sharp tackles this problem.

scenes.label: C# 8
scenes.sub: Nullable reference types catch null errors early.
scenes.say: Starting with version eight, C sharp can warn you about null issues before your code even runs.
Enable nullable reference types, mark variables as nullable or not, and let the compiler help you avoid mistakes.
A plain string must always have a value. A string with a question mark can be set to null.

scenes.question: How does C# warn about null?
scenes.right: It gives compiler warnings for possible null dereferences.
scenes.say: Don’t say C sharp only throws errors at runtime. It actually gives you warnings while you code.
